message.content: ChaeSong-hwa shared an article with LiHua that discusses how human beings form short-term and long-term memories. This discussion highlights the intricacies of the human brain and the ways in which our experiences, including emotions and context, influence our ability to recall events. LiHua was impressed by the complexity and importance of understanding memory formation, noting that even small moments can have a lasting impact on us. The conversation suggests that ChaeSong-hwa believes this knowledge could be beneficial in various fields, particularly in therapeutic settings and educational contexts, emphasizing the potential to enhance memory retention through practice and engaging activities.
